talentInfo.title: Simple Geometry
talentInfo.description: Quest: Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress.  Reward: Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

talentInfo.title: Warbreaker
talentInfo.description: Quest: Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker.  Reward: After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to Heroes.  Reward: After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Blow 'Em Up!
talentInfo.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Concussion Mine or Steel Trap causes Junkrat to deal 25% more damage with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities for 6 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Maximum Charge
talentInfo.description: Regen Globes now instantly grant 20 Energy.  Quest: Spend 150 seconds at or above 50 Energy.  Reward: Gain an additional 20 maximum Energy.

talentInfo.title: Thirst for Battle
talentInfo.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Bloodthirst by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Speed Barrier
talentInfo.description: Shield Ally increases the allied Hero's Movement Speed by 50% for the duration.

talentInfo.title: Arsenal
talentInfo.description: Increase the range of Multishot by 20%. Multishot also fires 3 grenades that deal 100 (+4% per level) damage and refund 25 Mana after hitting enemy Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Hot Pursuit
talentInfo.description: Increase the Movement Speed bonus of each stack of Hatred to 2%.

talentInfo.title: Pinpoint Accuracy
talentInfo.description: Particle Grenade deals 30 (+4% per level) more damage and Slows Movement Speed by 25% for 2 seconds to enemies hit by the center of the blast.

talentInfo.title: Perfect Defense
talentInfo.description: Deflected damage reduces the cooldown of Deflect by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Rain of Vengeance
talentInfo.description: Launch a wave of Shadow Beasts that deals 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns enemies in the target area for 0.5 seconds.  Stores up to 2 charges.

talentInfo.title: Dragonblade
talentInfo.description: Unleash the Dragonblade for 8 seconds. While active, Dragonblade can be reactivated to lunge forward and slash in a huge arc, dealing 240 (+4% per level) damage.

talentInfo.title: Primal Swarm
talentInfo.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds, causing them to take 10% extra damage.

talentInfo.title: Gloom
talentInfo.description: Activate to consume all Hatred, granting 3 Spell Armor per Hatred consumed for 5 seconds.  Passive: Gain 15 Spell Armor, and each stack of Hatred heals for 1.2 (+4% per level) Health per second.

talentInfo.title: Unstoppable Competitor
talentInfo.description: Personal Barrier makes Zarya Unstoppable for up to 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Phase Bulwark
talentInfo.description: Shield Overload grants 50 Spell Armor while active and for 2 seconds after it expires.

talentInfo.title: Manticore
talentInfo.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same Hero deals an additional 5% of their maximum Health as damage.

talentInfo.title: Punishment
talentInfo.description: While at max Hatred, Multishot's cooldown recharges 50% faster.

talentInfo.title: Final Cut
talentInfo.description: After 1 second, Swift Strike deals an additional 125 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in the area.

talentInfo.title: Shadow Mending
talentInfo.description: Heal for 60% of Spell Damage dealt to Heroes.

talentInfo.title: Tour Bus
talentInfo.description: Channeling Mosh Pit refreshes Powerslide's cooldown, and it can be cast to increase Mosh Pit's duration by 2 seconds.

talentInfo.title: Nowhere to Hide
talentInfo.description: The Hunt gains unlimited range. Illidan passively reveals enemy Heroes below 25% Health anywhere on the Battleground.

talentInfo.title: Zealot Charge
talentInfo.description: Increase Twin Blades' charge distance by 75%.

level_one.title: Static Charge
level_one.description: Quest: Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increases its damage by 5 and grants 33% Resonance Beam charge.  Maximum of 200 bonus damage.

level_four.title: Plasma Shield
level_four.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, gain a Shield equal to 3% of max Health every second, stacking up to 12%.

level_seven.title: Psionic Echo
level_seven.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

level_ten.title: Archon
level_ten.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.  Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

level_thirteen.title: Oracle
level_thirteen.description: Passive: While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12 (+4% per level) Health a second.  Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

level_sixteen.title: Thermal Lance
level_sixteen.description: Shock Ray deals an additional 8% of maximum Health as damage to the first Hero it hits.

level_twenty.title: Twilight Archon
level_twenty.description: Basic Attacks while in Archon form increase its duration by 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Static Charge
level_one.description: Quest: Heroes hit by Shock Ray permanently increases its damage by 5 and grants 33% Resonance Beam charge.  Maximum of 200 bonus damage.

level_four.title: Plasma Shield
level_four.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, gain a Shield equal to 3% of max Health every second, stacking up to 12%.

level_seven.title: Beam Alignment
level_seven.description: While Resonance Beam is fully charged, Shock Ray's cooldown refreshes 100% faster and its Slow duration is increased to 4 seconds.  Passive: Reduce the Mana cost of Shock Ray from 55 to 40.

level_ten.title: Archon
level_ten.description: Tassadar transforms into an Archon, gaining a Shield equal to 25% of his maximum Health and empowering Resonance Beam. Lasts for 12 seconds.  Resonance Beam: Deals 140 (+4% per level) damage to the target and splashes 70 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Heroes hit have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 2 seconds. Resonance Beam is fully charged while Archon is active.

level_thirteen.title: Oracle
level_thirteen.description: Passive: While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12 (+4% per level) Health a second.  Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

level_sixteen.title: Thermal Lance
level_sixteen.description: Shock Ray deals an additional 8% of maximum Health as damage to the first Hero it hits.

level_twenty.title: Twilight Archon
level_twenty.description: Basic Attacks while in Archon form increase its duration by 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Aether Walker
level_one.description: Teleport costs no Mana.  If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds.  Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

level_four.title: Triumvirate
level_four.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

level_seven.title: Calamity
level_seven.description: Teleport does 300 (+3% per level) damage to enemy Heroes near the destination.

level_ten.title: Wave Of Force
level_ten.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160 (+5% per level) damage.

level_thirteen.title: Illusionist
level_thirteen.description: If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed.  This effect has a 4 second cooldown.  Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

level_sixteen.title: Mirrorball
level_sixteen.description: Magic Missiles fires an additional 2 missiles, but its Mana cost is increased by 5.

level_twenty.title: Tal Rasha's Elements
level_twenty.description: Casting Abilities increases the damage of the next Ability by 5%, up to 20%.  This bonus is reset when the same Ability is used within a chain.

level_one.title: Field Study
level_one.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Scroll of Sealing grants 20% Spell Power for 16 seconds, up to 40%.

level_four.title: Ruby
level_four.description: Activate to increase the damage of the next Horadric Cube by 100%  and it spawns 3 Lesser Healing Potions from each enemy Hero hit, healing allied Heroes for 250 (+4% per level) when picked up. Lesser Healing Potions last for 10 seconds.  Only 1 Gem may be active at a time.

level_seven.title: Kanai's Cube
level_seven.description: Horadric Cube reduces Hero damage dealt by 30% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Stay Awhile and Listen
level_ten.description: After 1 second, Channel for 3 seconds, putting enemy Heroes in front of Deckard to Sleep while Channeling, and for 2 seconds after.  Enemies can only be put to Sleep once per cast, and Sleep's effects end instantly if they take damage.

level_thirteen.title: Ancient Blessings
level_thirteen.description: Activate Fortitude of the Faithful to empower nearby allied Hero Basic Attacks for 8 seconds, causing them to deal an additional 62 (+4% per level) damage in an area and heal for 90 (+4% per level) for each Hero hit. This effect can only occur once per second.

level_sixteen.title: Scroll of Stone Curse
level_sixteen.description: Scroll of Sealing deals 200% more damage when hitting at least 2 Heroes.

level_twenty.title: Perfect Gems
level_twenty.description: Reduce the cooldown of all Gems to 5 seconds and the cooldown of Horadric Cube by 6 seconds.

level_one.title: War Paint
level_one.description: Sonya's Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

level_four.title: Hurricane
level_four.description: Reduce the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 seconds. Casting Whirlwind removes all Slows and Roots from Sonya.

level_seven.title: Battle Rage
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly restore 10% of Sonya's maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Whirlwinding.  Passive: Sonya deals 25% more damage to Mercenaries.

level_ten.title: Wrath of the Berserker
level_ten.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

level_thirteen.title: Ruthless
level_thirteen.description: Whirlwind deals an additional 50 (+4% per level) damage per second to Heroes below 50% Health. Does not generate additional healing.

level_sixteen.title: Nerves of Steel
level_sixteen.description: Activate to gain 25% of your maximum Health as a Shield for 3 seconds. Usable while Whirlwinding.

level_twenty.title: Ignore Pain
level_twenty.description: Activate to gain 60 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 60% less damage. Usable while Whirlwinding.

level_one.title: Slumber Shells
level_one.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sleep Dart by 2 seconds. Upon waking, enemy Heroes are Slowed by 25% for 3 seconds.

level_four.title: Overdose
level_four.description: Sleep Dart applies 4 Doses.  While Aim Down Sights is active, Sleep Dart pierces all enemy Heroes.

level_seven.title: Night Terrors
level_seven.description: Gain 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds for every Hero hit by Sleep Dart. Upon waking, enemy Heroes take 8% of their Maximum Health in damage.

level_ten.title: Nano Boost
level_ten.description: Instantly boost an allied Hero, restoring 200 Mana. For the next 8 seconds, they gain 30% Spell Power and their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 150% faster.  Cannot be used on Ana.

level_thirteen.title: Purifying Darts
level_thirteen.description: Healing Dart removes Roots and Slows from the target, and heals for 20% more when doing so.

level_sixteen.title: Active Reload
level_sixteen.description: Activate to instantly gain 3 charges of Healing Dart.

level_twenty.title: Nano Infusion
level_twenty.description: Allies affected by Nano Boost heal for 50% of Spell Damage dealt.

level_one.title: Shackler
level_one.description: While Bone Armor is active, nearby enemies are Slowed by 35% for 1 second. Basic Attacks against Heroes that are Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor by 2 seconds.

level_four.title: Grim Scythe
level_four.description: Increase Xul's Basic Attack damage by 15%.  Each enemy hit by Cursed Strikes reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 12 seconds.

level_seven.title: Harvest Vitality
level_seven.description: Cursed Strikes heals for 70% of the damage dealt to Heroes.

level_ten.title: Poison Nova
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Rapid Harvest
level_thirteen.description: Gain 5% Attack Speed for 3 seconds each time Cursed Strikes hits an enemy, up to 75%.

level_sixteen.title: Weaken
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes who are damaged by Cursed Strikes or Skeletal Warriors deal 35% less damage for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Andariel's Visage
level_twenty.description: Poison Nova heals for 50% of the damage dealt and its duration is increased by 50%.
